title: Section 187 BNSS — Remand and default bail

content.overview: Section 187 is remand. Default bail lives here when the police report is not filed in the 60/90-day window, not in Section 193.
content.study: Produce the accused before the Magistrate. Police custody is limited. Count the days from remand. Do not confuse the chargesheet section with the default-bail clock.
